title: Measure right work, not just more work
look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: climbing volume counters under a vermillion question mark, an activity chart split between going well and going badly, a pair of metric cards with a deferred-work warning, Sensei's grouped metrics with velocity linked to its quality companion, and the Sensei end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.

scenes.name: More
scenes.desc: Volume counters climb: tokens, commits, lines changed under a vermillion question mark.

scenes.name: Busy is not good
scenes.desc: An activity chart: volume rises when work goes badly too, because fixing is activity.

scenes.name: The pair
scenes.desc: First-turn resolution and rework share, read together: rising rework means deferred work.

scenes.name: Grouped by answer
scenes.desc: Sensei groups metrics by what they answer; velocity links to its quality companion.

scenes.name: Sensei
scenes.desc: End card with the Sensei mark: measure right work, not more work.
